data.headline: PCYO reports higher third-quarter revenue on water demand and Sky Ranch activity

claims.text: Third-quarter revenue was $8.2 million versus $5.1 million in the prior-year period.

citation.quote: Revenue for the three and nine months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025 of $8.2 million and $22.5 million, and $5.1 million and $14.9 million, respectively

claims.text: Net income rose 31% to $2.9 million and diluted EPS rose 33% to $0.12.

citation.quote: Pure Cycle reported $2.9 million and $8.6 million of net income for the three and nine months ended May 31, 2026, respectively, which is a 31% and 23% increase in net income from the same periods in 2025 and marks the twenty-eighth consecutive fiscal quarter with positive net income. Pure Cycle reported $0.12 and $0.36 of earnings per fully diluted common share

claims.text: Water and wastewater revenue increased to $4.7 million from $2.1 million.

citation.quote: For the three months ended May 31, 2026 and 2025, we reported total revenue of $8.2 million and $5.1 million, respectively, with $4.7 million and $2.1 million being generated in our water and wastewater resource development segment

claims.text: Water deliveries rose to 631 acre-feet from 76 acre-feet, primarily because of increased demand from oil and gas customers.

citation.quote: Water deliveries increased for the three months ended May 31, 2026 to 631 acre-feet delivered as compared to 76 acre-feet delivered in the same period in 2025. The increase in water deliveries is primarily due to an increase in demand from our oil and gas customers.

claims.text: Lot sales revenue increased to $3.0 million from $2.5 million as favorable weather accelerated Sky Ranch development.

citation.quote: Lot sales revenue increased to $3.0 million for the three months ended May 31, 2026 compared to $2.5 million in the same period in 2025. Favorable weather conditions allowed us to advance our lot development schedule at Sky Ranch during the winter months

claims.text: The company has contracts for 23 of 33 additional rental homes, most expected available in calendar 2026.

citation.quote: We are currently under contract with several national homebuilders to construct 23 of the 33 additional single-family rental homes planned in Phases 2C and 2D at Sky Ranch, the majority of which we expect to be available for rent in calendar 2026.

claims.text: Phase 2D was approximately 84% complete, with substantial completion expected by fiscal 2026.

citation.quote: As of May 31, 2026, Phase 2A is complete, Phase 2B is approximately 99% complete, Phase 2C is approximately 95% complete, and Phase 2D is approximately 84% complete.

claims.text: The company expects approximately $14.8 million in milestone and finished-lot payments over the next 12 months.

citation.quote: As of May 31, 2026, we have an undrawn capacity of $10.0 million under a working capital line of credit and expect to receive approximately $14.8 million in milestone and finished lot payments from our homebuilder customers over the next 12 months

claims.text: The company has not yet secured a signed commitment for Phase 2E, despite several builders expressing interest.

citation.quote: With Phase 2E, while we have several builders who have expressed interest, we have chosen to continue development ahead of a signed commitment to take advantage of our seasonal construction windows
